description: The replica padrão at Diaz Point marking where Bartolomeu Dias raised a stone cross in July 1488
verification_note: The tall dark stone padrão on its granite boulder, the inscription 'Padrão de São Tiago Zebedeu — Bartolomeu Dias 25-7-1488' legible, open Atlantic behind. Smaller than our usual minimum at 1400 px wide.
